Path: changing a running app without code | studio-authoring.custom-page-render-and-blocks | P1

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src`: `DrawerForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `SplitForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx` and `WizardForm.tsx`. None of them reads `useDataInvalidation`; only `ObjectForm.tsx`'s default arm does (`:766` on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef`) ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: this is the rest of the behaviour objectui#10572 (p2, closed) declared for `object-form`. After `notifyDataChanged`, the five non-default arms keep the stale record (measured by the objectui#10682 dev's probe: `findOne` stays at 1 call on each of the five, and goes to 2 on the default arm). `reach:` a named real producer: on `origin/main`, `notifyDataChanged` is fired by `RecordDetailView`, `ObjectView`, `serverActionHandler`, `FlowRunner` and `RelatedRecordActionsBridge`. In addition, the pending `.changeset/10572-plugin-form-reads-invalidation-bus.md` would freeze a sentence into the next release that is true of one arm only. The parent's grade (p2) carries over.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T01:31Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), the six arm files on objectui `origin/main`, and the parent's triage comment `5831663042`.

**Direction.** The five arms read the bus with the default arm's pristine gate, in objectui#10572's shape (read the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for the record's object or `'*'`). Then the pending changeset's sentence is true as written. The parent card named `object-form` as one block, not one arm, so narrowing the changeset instead would leave a declared behaviour unenforced. If the claim cannot land before the next objectui release, say so here: the pending sentence then needs a scope note first.

**Serial constraints.** `WizardForm.tsx` is also objectui#10726 (graded this round). objectui#10682 and objectui#10712 are in flight on `plugin-form` arm files, each with PR 1 of 2 landed. No open PR touches the five files: the only open `plugin-form` PR, objectui#10650, holds `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and `LineItemsPanel.tsx`.

**Execution note.** Pin one probe per arm: a good first read, then `notifyDataChanged` for the record's object and for `'*'` ⇒ `findOne` goes to 2 on each. A dirty form must not re-read (the control).

Dedupe re-check: every open objectui issue (162), plus the 1000 most recently updated closed issues and PRs, grepped locally for the bus names next to the five arm names ⇒ only objectui#10572 (the parent, closed) and a seat post. No duplicate.
